title: desmodium obtusum
intro: Desmodium obtusum, commonly known as stick-tight or tick-trefoil, is a perennial legume plant native to tropical regions of the Americas and the Caribbean. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders. The health benefits of Desmodium obtusum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic and antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents of Desmodium obtusum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
